reason: On $26k a year, $25 to $30 a month for one supplement is real money, and I already forget pills at home. I would rather spend that on gym stuff and food.
objection: It is $30 every month for something I am not sure I need, and two capsules every day is one more thing to remember.
would_change_my_mind: A price around $15 for the 30 days, or a cheap small trial box so I can see if it does anything for me before paying full price.
